title: Provisioning RBAC: only privileged actors may create teams and users
spec: The provisioning endpoints (create team, create user) currently accept any authenticated actor, so any team member can mint new teams and identities. Add role-based enforcement in the auth runtime: define which roles may provision, guard the provisioning routes with it (403 with a clear reason for non-privileged actors), and extend the multi-user integration test to cover both the denied and allowed paths.
